# google_resource_manager_capability_config

Capability configs define the enabled capabilities and their scope of
enforcement for folders, organizations, or projects within the resource hierarchy.


To get more information about CapabilityConfig, see:

* [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/resource-manager/reference/rest)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/manage-applications)

## Example Usage - Resource Manager Capability Config Basic


```hcl
resource "google_resource_manager_capability_config" "capability_config" {
  parent               = "organizations/123456789"
  capability_config_id = "capcfg"
  display_name         = "capdisp"
  types                = ["AGENT_MANAGEMENT"]
}
```
## Example Usage - Resource Manager Capability Config Folder


```hcl
resource "google_folder" "folder" {
  display_name        = "capcfg-fldr"
  parent              = "organizations/123456789"
  deletion_protection = false
}

# An existing project can be supplied as the management project. If
# management_project is omitted, the API creates one automatically.
resource "google_project" "management_project" {
  project_id      = "capcfg-mgmt"
  name            = "capcfg-mgmt"
  folder_id       = google_folder.folder.folder_id
  billing_account = "000000-0000000-0000000-000000"
  deletion_policy = "DELETE"
}

// wait for project creation
resource "time_sleep" "wait_60_seconds" {
  create_duration = "60s"
  depends_on = [google_project.management_project]
}

resource "google_resource_manager_capability_config" "capability_config" {
  parent               = google_folder.folder.name
  capability_config_id = "capcfg"
  display_name         = "Folder capability config"
  types                = ["AGENT_MANAGEMENT"]
  management_project   = "projects/${google_project.management_project.number}"
  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_60_seconds]
}
```
## Example Usage - Resource Manager Capability Config Project


```hcl
resource "google_project" "project" {
  project_id      = "capcfg-proj"
  name            = "capcfg-proj"
  org_id          = "123456789"
  billing_account = "000000-0000000-0000000-000000"
  deletion_policy = "DELETE"
}

// wait for project creation
resource "time_sleep" "wait_60_seconds" {
  create_duration = "60s"
  depends_on = [google_project.project]
}

resource "google_resource_manager_capability_config" "capability_config" {
  parent               = "projects/${google_project.project.number}"
  capability_config_id = "capcfg"
  display_name         = "Project capability config"
  types                = ["AGENT_MANAGEMENT"]
  management_project   = "projects/${google_project.project.number}"
  depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_60_seconds]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `types` -
  (Required)
  The capabilities enabled for the resource and its sub-tree.
  Possible values: "AGENT_MANAGEMENT".

* `parent` -
  (Required)
  The parent resource in which to create the capability config.
  Format: `folders/{folder_id}`, `organizations/{organization_id}`, or `projects/{project_number}`.

* `capability_config_id` -
  (Required)
  User-specified identifier of the capability config. Must be 6 to 30 characters,
  and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined name for the capability config. Must be between 4 and 30 characters.

* `management_project` -
  (Optional)
  The management project for the capability config. If unspecified, a project will be created automatically.
  Must be specified for project-scoped capability config.
  Format: `projects/{project_number}`.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{parent}}/capabilityConfigs/{{capability_config_id}}`

* `name` -
  The identifier for the capability config.
  Format: `{parent}/capabilityConfigs/{capability_config_id}`.

* `state` -
  The state of the capability config.

* `etag` -
  An opaque tag indicating the current version of the capability config, used for concurrency control.

* `create_time` -
  The time when the capability config was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time when the capability config was last updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


CapabilityConfig can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `{{parent}}/capabilityConfigs/{{capability_config_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import CapabilityConfig using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    parent = "<-required value->"
    capability_config_id = "<-required value->"
  }
  to = google_resource_manager_capability_config.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import CapabilityConfig using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "{{parent}}/capabilityConfigs/{{capability_config_id}}"
  to = google_resource_manager_capability_config.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), CapabilityConfig can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_resource_manager_capability_config.default {{parent}}/capabilityConfigs/{{capability_config_id}}
```
